name: ChatGPT Plus
tagline: OpenAI's flagship multi-modal AI assistant with GPT-6.2 Sol & Astra models, ChatGPT Work, Codex agent, and Dot.
bestFor: General productivity, frontier reasoning, Codex & ChatGPT Work workflows, data analysis, and multi-modal tasks
pros: Access to frontier GPT-6.2 Sol & Astra models (1.05M context window), Codex coding agent, and ChatGPT Work desktop/web apps
Strong multi-modal suite with advanced voice, image generation, custom Projects, and Dot always-on agent on Pro
Flexible consumer lineup with Free ($0) & Go ($8/mo) on GPT-6 Luna, Plus ($20/mo), and Pro ($100/$200/$500/mo)
cons: No annual discount on individual Plus ($20/mo) subscriptions; Go ($8/mo) tier may include ads
Heavy power users require Pro tiers ($100-$500/mo) for Dot, highest limits, API credits, and Ultrafast mode

name: Claude Pro
tagline: Anthropic's high-context AI assistant featuring Claude Code, Cowork, Projects, Artifacts, and Fable 5.2 / Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5.
bestFor: Software engineering, Claude Code terminal workflows, long-document analysis, and nuanced writing
pros: Includes Claude Code, Projects, Artifacts, Cowork, and 1M token context across Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, and Fable 5.2 (included up to half weekly limit on Max/Ultra)
Annual billing reduces Pro to $17/mo ($200/yr); Max ($100/mo) and Ultra ($200/mo) bundle matching monthly API credits
Industry-leading code refactoring accuracy, Claude in Chrome/Microsoft 365, and zero long-context surcharge up to 1M tokens
cons: Pro enforces 5-hour rolling usage windows; removing the 5-hour cap requires Ultra ($200/mo) on verified accounts
No built-in raster image generation

name: Google AI Pro (Gemini Advanced)
tagline: Google's Google AI Pro suite combining Gemini 4 Neon & Argon models, Deep Research, Workspace AI, and 5TB storage.
bestFor: Google Workspace users, Deep Research reports, long-context video/audio analysis, and cloud storage bundles
pros: Bundle includes 5 TB Google One storage, $10/mo Google Cloud/Gemini API credits, YouTube Premium Lite, and Deep Research at $19.99/mo ($199.99/yr)
1M+ token context window on Gemini 4 Neon & Argon with native integration across Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Sheets
AI Plus ($4.99/mo, 400GB, Gemini 4 Hydrogen) and AI Ultra 5x ($99.99/mo, 20TB) / 20x ($199.99/mo, 30TB) scale from light to heavy users
cons: Gemini 4 Carbon models, Google Antigravity priority, YouTube Premium Family, and 2,000 Colab GPU units require $99.99-$199.99/mo AI Ultra tiers
Scheduled API price increases take effect Dec 1, 2026 (Gemini 4 Argon & Carbon doubling from $2/$10 to $4/$20 per 1M tokens)

name: Grok (The X Subscription)
tagline: xAI's Grok 4.7 assistant and multimodal API (Image 2.0, Video 1.5, Voice), bundled with Cursor via The X Subscription.
bestFor: Real-time X/web intelligence, bundled Grok + Cursor subscribers, and xAI agentic API workloads
pros: Unified X Subscription bundles Grok + Cursor usage across Plus ($8/mo), Premium ($30/mo), Super ($100/mo), and Ultra ($200/mo)
Flagship Grok 4.7 API offers 500K context at $2/$6 per 1M tokens alongside Image 2.0 ($0.02+/img), Video 1.5 ($0.02+/sec), and Voice APIs
Includes real-time X platform context, Grok Build, Imagine, and video generation on Premium+
cons: Standalone SuperGrok plans were phased out for new sign-ups in favor of The X Subscription bundle
API requests reaching 200K+ tokens double token pricing across the entire prompt

name: DeepSeek
tagline: High-efficiency AI assistant and V4-series reasoning API featuring 1M context, 384K max output, and ultra-low token costs.
bestFor: Cost-sensitive developers, high-volume reasoning APIs, and free consumer chat with web search
pros: Free consumer web and mobile chat with built-in web search, deep thinking, and file/PDF parsing
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ($0.15/$0.60 per 1M off-peak, Vision enabled) and DeepSeek-V4-Pro ($0.66/$1.98 per 1M off-peak) support 1M context & 384K max output
Automatic context caching drops cache-hit input to $0.003-$0.022/1M off-peak; server-side web search/fetch tool calls are no longer billed separately (Nov 18 update)
cons: Peak weekday API hours (01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC) double token rates compared to off-peak windows
Standalone Search & Fetch APIs carry a $0.75 per 1,000 requests fee; V4-Pro lacks vision input

name: Cursor
tagline: AI-first IDE bundled with The X Subscription, offering Cloud Agents, Origin code hosting, and Bugbot PR reviews.
bestFor: Full-stack engineers wanting multi-file Cloud Agents, Bugbot PR reviews, and fast Tab autocomplete
pros: Plus starts at $8/mo; Premium ($30/mo) unlocks 4x usage, Cloud Agents, Bugbot reviews, and Origin hosting; scales to Super ($100, 15x) & Ultra ($200, 50x)
Seamless VS Code compatibility with codebase indexing, CLI, and fast multi-line Tab predictions
Bundled with The X Subscription, sharing usage pools across Cursor and Grok Chat, Build, Voice & Imagine
cons: Third-party models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) require Premium ($30/mo+) and bill separately at API list prices
Plus ($8/mo) restricts Cursor to Grok models and excludes Cloud Agents, Automations, Origin, and Bugbot

name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: GitHub's multi-IDE AI coding assistant with Copilot Fusion, 3rd-party agents (Claude Code & Codex), and AI Credits.
bestFor: Individual developers and enterprise teams standardized on GitHub, VS Code, or JetBrains IDEs
pros: Copilot Free ($0, 2,000 completions/mo) and Pro ($10/mo, unlimited completions + 1,500 AI Credits worth $15 + Claude Code/Codex agents)
Scales cleanly with Pro+ ($39/mo, 7,000 credits, Copilot Fusion High/Max, Opus), Max ($100/mo, 20,000 credits), Business ($19), and Enterprise ($39)
Strong enterprise IP indemnity, no-training privacy guarantees, and native GitHub PR integration
cons: Heavy agentic coding workflows consume monthly GitHub AI Credits quickly on the $10 Pro plan

name: Windsurf
tagline: Agentic AI code editor in Cognition's Devin ecosystem with free SWE-2 on Pro, Devin Cloud, and unlimited Tab edits.
bestFor: Developers seeking autonomous SWE-2 & Devin Cloud workflows, unlimited inline edits, and API-rate overages
pros: Unlimited Tab autocomplete and inline edits across Free ($0), Pro ($20/mo), Max ($200/mo), and Teams ($80/mo base up to 100 users)
Pro includes free use of Cognition's latest SWE-2 model, Devin Cloud access, and ability to use an existing ChatGPT plan
Full frontier model availability (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, xAI, open-source) with transparent API-rate overages
cons: Devin Bots require the Max ($200/mo) or Teams ($80/mo+) tiers
No standalone public consumer REST API on individual IDE plans (Devin API is Teams+)

name: Lovable
tagline: Full-stack AI web application builder with unified Lovable Cloud hosting, Plan/Default modes, custom domains, and code export.
bestFor: Founders, product managers, and designers shipping full-stack web apps and MVPs from natural language
pros: Unified credit pool covers AI app building, Lovable Cloud hosting, connectors, and embedded in-app AI features
Pro starts at $25/mo ($250/yr, ~$21/mo) for 100 monthly credits, daily 5-credit grants, custom domains, and code export
Free tier offers 5 daily credits (capped at 30/mo) and 20 Cloud credits for rapid prototyping
cons: Complex iterative debugging in Default Mode can burn monthly build credits rapidly on lower tiers
Business tier starts at $50/mo ($500/yr, ~$42/mo) for team workspaces, security center, and SSO

name: Bolt.new
tagline: Browser-native full-stack AI development sandbox with token-based billing, hosting, and unlimited databases.
bestFor: Rapid in-browser prototyping, full-stack web deployments, and interactive frontend/backend builds
pros: Generous Free plan includes 1M tokens/month (300K/day cap), up to 333K web requests, and unlimited databases
Pro ($25/mo monthly, save up to 28% yearly) removes daily caps and provides 10M tokens/month with rollover, 1M web requests, and custom domains
Zero local setup required—runs Node.js, packages, AI image editing, and database connectors directly in the browser
cons: Large multi-file context loops consume token allowances quickly during debugging
Teams plan ($30/member/mo) required for centralized billing, private NPM registries, and design system knowledge

name: Perplexity Pro
tagline: Real-time AI answer and Deep Research engine with live citations, Model Council, Perplexity Computer, and Agent/Search APIs.
bestFor: Market researchers, journalists, students, and analysts needing verified, cited real-time research
pros: Every answer provides clickable source citations with multi-step Deep Research synthesis and multi-model switching
Flexible pricing across Free ($0), Education Pro ($10/mo), Pro ($20/mo or $200/yr), and Max ($200/mo or $2,000/yr)
Modular developer platform features flat-rate Search API ($5 per 1,000 requests) alongside the Perplexity Agent API
cons: Less suited for creative fiction writing or multi-file software repository editing
Model Council, highest Deep Research limits, and 10,000 monthly Perplexity Computer credits require the $200/mo Max tier

name: n8n
tagline: Fair-code workflow and AI agent automation platform priced per full workflow execution with MCP triggers and free self-hosting.
bestFor: Technical builders, DevOps teams, and agencies building multi-step AI agents and API workflows
pros: Free self-hosted Community Edition (212K+ GitHub stars); Cloud Starter is €20/mo annual (€24 monthly) for 2,500 executions and 1,600 Assistant credits
Charged per complete workflow run regardless of step count, with unlimited users, unlimited workflows, and bundled AI models without API keys
Native AI Agent, MCP Server Trigger, memory, and LangChain nodes plus custom JavaScript/Python support
cons: Steeper technical learning curve than consumer no-code tools
Cloud Pro (€50/mo annual, €60 monthly) needed for 10,000 executions, 50 concurrent runs, and up to 9,600 Assistant credits

name: Make (formerly Integromat)
tagline: Visual drag-and-drop automation canvas with credit-based pricing, Make Code JS/Python app, and 1,500+ apps.
bestFor: No-code operators, marketers, and SMBs automating CRM, content, and AI API pipelines visually
pros: Free plan includes 1,000 credits/mo; Core starts at $12/mo annual ($16/mo monthly) for 10,000 credits/mo and 1-minute scheduling
Pro ($21/mo annual / $28 monthly) adds priority execution and full-text log search; Teams starts at $38/mo annual ($51 monthly)
Routers and filters do not consume credits; includes Make API and Make Code JS/Python modules
cons: Unused monthly credits expire at billing cycle end and polling triggers consume credits on every check
No self-hosted open-source deployment option

name: Zapier
tagline: The largest no-code automation ecosystem with 9,000+ app connectors, Zapier MCP, AI Agents, Tables, and Interfaces.
bestFor: Non-technical teams needing instant connectors across niche enterprise and SMB SaaS tools and MCP agents
pros: Massive ecosystem of 9,000+ integrations plus Zapier MCP (10,000+ apps for AI agents), Agents, Tables, and Forms on Free
Professional starts at $19.99/mo billed annually ($29.99/mo monthly) for multi-step Zaps, webhooks, AI fields, and Zapier Copilot
Filters, Paths, Formatters, and Triggers do not count against monthly task limits
cons: Task-based pricing scales up steeply for high-volume workflows; Team starts at $69/mo annual for 25 users and SAML SSO

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: Studio-grade AI voice platform powered by Eleven v4 & v4 Turbo, dubbing, SFX, music, and conversational voice agents.
bestFor: Content creators, audiobook publishers, game studios, and low-latency conversational voice AI apps
pros: New Eleven v4 ($0.08/1K chars) and Eleven v4 Turbo ($0.04/1K chars, ~100ms latency) deliver studio-grade emotive speech
Starter starts at $5/mo annual ($6/mo monthly) for 30,000 credits, commercial rights, Dubbing Studio, and instant voice cloning
Creator ($18.33/mo annual / $22 monthly, 121K credits) unlocks Pro Voice Cloning; Pro ($82.50/mo annual / $99 monthly) adds 600K credits & 44.1kHz PCM API
cons: Free tier (10,000 credits/mo) excludes commercial usage rights
Dubbing and complex multi-speaker workflows consume credits faster than standard TTS

name: Runway
tagline: AI video creation studio and Dev API featuring Gen-4.5, Aleph 2.0, Kling 4.0, App Studio, and Runway MCP.
bestFor: Filmmakers, creative directors, marketing teams, and developers building AI video pipelines
pros: Standard starts at $12/mo annual (promotional discounts available) for 625 credits/mo, App Studio, Runway Ads, watermark removal, and 4K upscaling
Pro ($28/mo annual, 2,250 credits) & Max ($76/mo annual, 9,500 credits) add Runway MCP, Topaz AI Upscale Unlimited, ProRes/HDR, and 1-month rollover
Multi-model hub supports Gen-4.5, Aleph 2.0, Kling 4.0, Seedance 2.5, and Nano Banana Pro alongside the pay-per-second Runway Dev API
cons: Free tier only includes 125 one-time sign-up credits rather than a recurring monthly allowance
Older Unlimited tier was replaced by credit-capped Standard, Pro, and Max plans

name: Suno
tagline: AI music creation platform featuring v6 / v6-wild models, Suno Studio browser DAW with MIDI & plugins, and stem separation.
bestFor: Musicians, video creators, podcasters, and indie studios generating original tracks and stems
pros: Free grants 50 daily credits (v6-mini); Pro ($8/mo annual / $10 monthly) unlocks v6 & v6-wild models, 2,500 credits, and commercial rights
Premier ($24/mo annual / $30 monthly) adds 10,000 credits, 60 downloads/mo, 3 stem types, and Suno Studio DAW (MIDI, effects, automation, custom plugins)
Platinum ($100/mo annual / $120 monthly) scales to 15,000 song credits, 20,000 visual credits, and 120 monthly song downloads
cons: No official self-serve public developer API available
Monthly track download caps apply (20 on Pro, 60 on Premier, 120 on Platinum)

name: Midjourney
tagline: Premier AI image generation platform powered by V8.2 native 2K HD, unified Edit Model, Unlimited Relax, and Stealth privacy.
bestFor: Art directors, concept artists, brand designers, and agencies needing photorealistic and stylized imagery
pros: Basic starts at $8/mo annual ($10/mo monthly) for 200 Fast GPU mins (~3.3 hrs) and commercial rights for individuals/small teams
Standard ($24/mo annual / $30 monthly) adds 15 Fast GPU hours and Unlimited Relax images on V8.2 native 2K HD + 4-ref Edit Model
Pro ($48/mo annual / $60 monthly) and Mega ($96/mo annual / $120 monthly) unlock Stealth mode, Unlimited Relax SD video, and 12 concurrent jobs
cons: No permanent free tier and no official public REST API
Basic plan excludes Relax/Stealth modes, and companies over $1M gross annual revenue must use Pro or Mega
